## How I tested it

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test` (added/updated tests for behavior changes)
- [ ] `npm run build && npm start` + `npm run smoke` (if the server changed)

## Checklist

- [ ] UI text is in both English and Arabic (`src/i18n.ts`)
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, README, CHANGELOG) if behavior or config changed
- [ ] No secrets, real personal data, private URLs or screenshots of real content
- [ ] Security properties kept (path checks, blocked types, size caps, sandbox CSP, token hashing)
